_comment: EXAMPLE theme set (security and resilience), a template for your own. Theme definitions for theme_exposure.py. A company is in a theme if a segment matches (segment_regex or segment_naics, minus segment_exclude), or its GICS sub-industry starts with a gics_core prefix, or its name matches include_names, or its business description matches busdesc_regex. 'Core group' in the summary = segment share >= 50%, GICS core, or name include, excluding utilities (GICS sector 55). anchor_customers finds second-order suppliers.
